title: Type the reply note only into a real agent program, and two cue follow-ups
body:
Review findings on commit b6c88e9 (read its body, then docs/remote-sessions.md). Small, exact fixes. The human's standing requirement: proven by driving the real application; reproduce item 1 BEFORE the fix and verify it AFTER, recorded the same way as b6c88e9 (its card: `foreman kanban list b83asp --json`; reuse its setup paragraph: own release build under target/agent/, config dir target/agent/appdata-s2hp4s, own pipe, test Remote andy@192.168.8.168 key login, clean up what you create, never stop a foreman by name, never print a token in the repo, install nothing on the Remote).
Blocked by: Reply note before carried posts on reconnect, restore the hookless launch note, and finish the held-chat cue
1. MUST FIX. The reply note is typed into commands that are not agents. remote::typed_route decides from remote::agent_of, which goes through icons::IconKind::from_argv; that falls back to a substring scan over the whole command line when the program's stem is not an agent name. With b6c88e9's rule (not Claude means type the note at Ready), `foreman open --on R -- vim codex.md` or `tail -f /var/log/grok.log` is classed Codex or Grok and gets the note pasted plus Enter into vim or tail. Fix: the note is typed at launch only when the PROGRAM is the agent: argv[0]'s file stem equals the agent name exactly (case-insensitive, as remote::hooked_claude does), or argv[0] is a known wrapper (npx and whatever wrappers the code already recognises: find them, do not invent a list) whose agent argument is itself an exact name or package. Anything else that merely mentions an agent gets the note with its first chat post (WithFirstPost), never typed. Do NOT change icons::IconKind::from_argv or the tab icon behaviour; add an exact predicate in remote.rs and make typed_route, note_route, hooked_claude and the chat-hold choice agree through it. Check the same looseness does not let a non-agent command get hook settings, a chat hold, or an in-prompt note; list what you checked. Extend the typed_route table test with: vim codex.md, tail -f grok.log, cat claude.txt, /opt/claude/bin/python script.py, bash -c "codex ...", npx forms, env VAR=1 codex "brief", and the real agent shapes, each with its expected route.
   Reproduce live BEFORE (on main as it is): on the Remote, `vim codex.md` in a throwaway /tmp directory opened through `foreman open --on falador --cwd ... -- vim codex.md`; snapshot shows the note typed into vim. AFTER: nothing typed; a later chat post to that pane carries the note. Quit vim without saving and remove the directory.
2. SHOULD FIX. src/terminal.rs pointer_over_bar / selection_finished: press_origin is cleared by the release event itself, so on the release frame of a drag that began on the cue or the search bar and ended off it, the drag-stop path runs copy_selection when copy_on_select is on and re-copies a stale selection to the clipboard. A drag that started on a bar must be ignored through its release frame. Add the release frame to a_drag_from_the_held_cue_starts_no_selection (and the search-bar equivalent), asserting the clipboard path is not taken.
3. SHOULD FIX. held_cue_tooltip builds its string every frame the cue is shown, hovered or not; build it only on hover (on_hover_ui or equivalent lazy form). Leave the three-galley layout alone unless it is trivial to cache.
Not in scope: whether a Remote Codex should get a typed note at launch at all given its update prompt (a human decision, documented already).
Hard rules as before: nothing assumes foreman on the Remote; a Remote agent's allowed actions are unchanged; no wire change; nothing under cfg(test) spawns a process or socket outside the remote_probe network guard.
Done when:
- one exact "program is this agent" predicate feeds every Remote launch decision, with the extended table test
- BEFORE and AFTER for item 1 observed on the real Remote and recorded in the commit body and a short spec Results entry
- the release-frame test and the lazy tooltip are in; docs/remote-sessions.md and both providers' dispatch skill copies corrected only where they are now wrong; cite-guard clean; full suite passes
Gate: cargo test --target-dir target/agent; pwsh -File .claude/hooks/cite-guard.ps1 -All
